summary: Tier System API testing complete. All 30 tests passed (100%). The 3-tier subscription system (Starter/Pro/Business) with feature gating is fully functional.
passed_tests: ✅ GET /api/tiers/plans - Returns all 3 subscription plans (public endpoint)
✅ Starter plan: $0/month, correct highlights (1 Webstore, 25 AI generations, etc.)
✅ All authenticated endpoints return 401 without token
✅ GET /api/tiers/my-plan - Returns tenant's tier and all features
✅ Feature categories present: customer_portal, webstores, ai_tools, team, core_modules, analytics, pricing
✅ ON features (ai_tools.text_tools, customer_portal.portal_access, core_modules.jobs) return allowed=true
✅ OFF features (ai_tools.image_generation, core_modules.kanban, core_modules.time_clock) return allowed=false with upgrade message
✅ LIMITED features (ai_tools.monthly_generations, webstores.num_stores, team.team_members) return limit, current_usage, remaining
✅ POST /api/tiers/use/{category}/{feature} - Increments usage for LIMITED features
✅ Using ON features succeeds without usage tracking
✅ Using OFF features returns 403 with error detail
✅ GET /api/tiers/usage - Returns all usage records with percentage
✅ GET /api/tiers/upgrade-prompt - Returns correct unlock tier and pricing
✅ Invalid category/feature combinations handled gracefully (return OFF status)
critical_code_review_comments: Tier system implementation is clean and well-structured
Feature gating service properly handles ON/OFF/LIMITED states
Usage tracking correctly increments and persists to MongoDB
Upgrade prompts correctly identify which tier unlocks each feature
All tier configurations match the product requirements (Starter: 25 AI gens, 1 store, 1 team member; Pro: 100 AI gens, 5 stores, 5 team members; Business: unlimited)
